hosted_ci.workflow: WP105 Direct Retry Identity E3 Falsifier
hosted_ci.step: Run zero-effect direct retry identity discriminator

observed_discriminators.meaning: After harmless child-start marking plus UNKNOWN, closing and reopening the SQLite authority preserves the operation fence; the same scoped logical operation performs zero additional child mutation and reuses the unresolved attempt/effect identities rather than dispatching again.
The same user/session/operation_retry_id with a changed operation_payload_sha256 rejects transactionally before a second attempt row or dispatch-capable admission.
Identical effect semantics under a distinct operation_retry_id remain independently admissible with fresh attempt_id and effect_id.

UNKNOWN remains blocked until explicit authority-owned VERIFIED_NOT_APPLIED evidence is recorded; only then is a fresh attempt with fresh attempt_id/effect_id admitted while preserving the prior attempt record.

hypothesis_update.prior: A stable operation_retry_id plus retry-stable payload digest persisted in the existing authority may be sufficient to close the direct duplicate-dispatch class.
hypothesis_update.important_refinement: Identity fields alone are not the demonstrated mechanism. The passing prototype requires transactional claim plus explicit PENDING/DISPATCH_STARTED/UNKNOWN/VERIFIED_NOT_APPLIED state and verification evidence; this supports the stronger counterhypothesis that authority-owned dispatch/outcome state is part of the minimum safe native repair.

remaining_falsifiers: Current canonical EntityOS schema/source has not been patched or proven to implement this ABI.
No multi-process/concurrent contention acceptance has been granted beyond SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE semantics exercised by the sequential reopen suite.
Schema migration/backward-compatibility against the exact current EffectJournal effects table remains unproven.
The current live bridge still has the separately observed post-dispatch FAILED-vs-UNKNOWN semantic gap until canonical authority changes it.
No real external effect was used, so no world-effect outcome claim exists.

next_gate.instruction: Bind this proven research shape to exact current EntityOS/F2 source without a second authority: add fail-closed current-source tests for durable operation scope, changed-payload mismatch, unresolved duplicate suppression and post-dispatch UNKNOWN semantics; only then consider the minimum native EffectJournal schema/state-machine patch under the canonical mutation owner.
